Definition: of Hebrew origin (H3878); Levi, the name of three Israelites:--Levi. Compare G3018.
BiblicalUsage: Leuḯ names Levi, and its appearances in Scripture are few but pointed. In Mark 2:14, "he saw Levi the [son] of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom"; and in Luke 3:24, "which was [the son] of Levi". In Hebrews 7:5, "And verily they that are of the sons of Levi".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Levi is three men in one name — the patriarch whose sons became priests, the ancestor in Jesus' line, and the tax collector who left his booth to follow Him. I hold that the same name runs from the tribe to the table of Matthew, and God used every one of them.
